disclaimer: All data in this folder are synthetic, generated to illustrate the method. They do not come from Meta, any client, or any real organization. The goal is to show how a business question, a measurement strategy, the statistics, and the code connect end to end.

notes.rounding: AUC and probabilities 2 decimals; score points 1 decimal; shares whole percent; MAE 3 decimals
notes.intervals: 95% percentile bootstrap, 1,000 resamples of learners, Park-Miller RNG seed 20261106 shared by Python and R
notes.split: train/test by learner, from the 'split' column in data/learners.csv (identical in both languages)

n_learners.meaning: Synthetic learners in the course (60 teams, 3 business units).

n_events.meaning: Logged tutor actions (rows in tutor_events.csv), before cleaning.

n_unreadable_tokens_dropped.meaning: Unreadable action codes ('?') dropped during cleaning.

n_missing_post_test.meaning: Learners with no post-test: kept in the logs and the style mixture, excluded from gain analyses (not imputed).

n_short_logs_under_5_actions.meaning: Learners with fewer than 5 logged actions (very short logs, mostly early drop-outs).

n_train_with_post.meaning: Training learners with a post-test (used to fit every model).

n_test_with_post.meaning: Held-out learners with a post-test (used only to evaluate).

share_gained.meaning: Percent of learners (with a post-test) who gained 10+ points.

r_messages_gain.meaning: Naive: correlation between number of tutor messages and gain (points).

r_minutes_gain.meaning: Naive: correlation between minutes with the tutor and gain (points).

mean_messages_gained.meaning: Mean messages per learner among those who gained 10+ points.

mean_messages_not_gained.meaning: Mean messages per learner among those who did not gain 10+ points.

gain_top_quartile_markov.meaning: Mean gain (points) of held-out learners in the top quartile of the Markov log-score.

gain_bottom_quartile_markov.meaning: Mean gain (points) of held-out learners in the bottom quartile of the Markov log-score.

auc_volume.meaning: Held-out AUC, rung (a): logistic regression on messages, minutes, sessions (0.50 = coin flip).

auc_bag.meaning: Held-out AUC, rung (b): logistic regression on shares of each action type, order ignored.

auc_markov1.meaning: Held-out AUC, rung (c): first-order Markov log-score (gain chain vs no-gain chain).

auc_markov2.meaning: Held-out AUC, rung (d): second-order Markov log-score (two steps of memory; richer model).

auc_diff_m1_minus_bag.meaning: AUC gain from adding ORDER: first-order Markov minus bag of actions.

auc_diff_m1_minus_volume.meaning: AUC gain of first-order Markov over usage volume.

auc_diff_m2_minus_m1.meaning: AUC gain of the richer second-order chain over the first-order chain (about zero: the true process is first-order).

gain_diff_top_vs_bottom_quartile.meaning: Gain gap (points), top minus bottom quartile of the Markov log-score, held-out learners.

p_AC_gained.meaning: P(copy | full answer) among learners who gained 10+ points.

p_AC_not.meaning: P(copy | full answer) among learners who did not gain.

p_HT_gained.meaning: P(attempt | hint) among learners who gained.

p_HT_not.meaning: P(attempt | hint) among learners who did not gain.

p_HA_gained.meaning: P(full answer | hint) among learners who gained.

p_HA_not.meaning: P(full answer | hint) among learners who did not gain.

p_AT_gained.meaning: P(re-attempt | full answer) among learners who gained.

p_AT_not.meaning: P(re-attempt | full answer) among learners who did not gain.

p_TV_gained.meaning: P(verify | attempt) among learners who gained (similar across groups: verifying alone is not the signal).

p_TV_not.meaning: P(verify | attempt) among learners who did not gain.

p_AC_not_minus_gained.meaning: Answer->copy loop rate, not-gained minus gained (probability points).

p_HT_gained_minus_not.meaning: Hint->attempt rate, gained minus not-gained (probability points).

p_AC_low_prior_quartile.meaning: P(copy | full answer) in the lowest pre-test quartile (confounding: style tracks prior skill).

p_AC_high_prior_quartile.meaning: P(copy | full answer) in the highest pre-test quartile.

mae_transition_true_labels.meaning: Ground truth: mean absolute error of estimated vs true transition probabilities, chains fit with the true style labels.

mae_transition_em.meaning: Ground truth: same error for chains recovered WITHOUT labels by a 3-style mixture of Markov chains (EM).

style_accuracy_em.meaning: Ground truth: percent of learners the unlabeled mixture assigns to their true style.

style_share_true_scaffolded.meaning: Ground truth: percent of learners whose true style is scaffolded (realized in this sample).

style_share_em_scaffolded.meaning: Percent of learners the unlabeled mixture estimates as scaffolded.

style_share_true_answer_seeking.meaning: Ground truth: percent of learners whose true style is answer_seeking (realized in this sample).

style_share_em_answer_seeking.meaning: Percent of learners the unlabeled mixture estimates as answer_seeking.

style_share_true_light_mixed.meaning: Ground truth: percent of learners whose true style is light_mixed (realized in this sample).

style_share_em_light_mixed.meaning: Percent of learners the unlabeled mixture estimates as light_mixed.

mean_gain_true_scaffolded.meaning: Mean observed gain (points) for learners whose TRUE style is scaffolded.

mean_gain_true_answer_seeking.meaning: Mean observed gain (points) for learners whose TRUE style is answer-seeking.

mean_gain_true_light_mixed.meaning: Mean observed gain (points) for learners whose TRUE style is light/mixed.

auc_ngram_mlp.meaning: Held-out AUC of a small neural net (MLP, 16 hidden units) on 1-3-gram shares; stand-in for a neural sequence model; Python only.
